title: Claim and complete cross tenant boundaries

promptSteps.prompt: A worker at one tenant was handed a job that belongs to a different tenant, and was able to complete it. QueueDesk is supposed to keep tenants apart: `claim` hands back only jobs the acting tenant owns, and `complete` refuses a job the acting tenant cannot see. Please fix the cause. Keep the decision recorded in DECISIONS.md that a job belonging to another tenant and a job that does not exist answer the same way, so that one tenant cannot learn whether another tenant's job exists. Run `npm test` in the project root to check your work.
